summary: Identity proxy header truncation prevents new hire onboarding & tool login
description: Issue summary: New hires and some service accounts are intermittently unable to finish SSO login to internal developer tools (console, runbook editor). Failures began after a recent Okta claim-normalization rollout. Impact: onboarding blocked for ~4 hires, intermittent 403s for automation jobs, delayed oncall provisioning. User-facing error is '403 Forbidden - missing role claim'.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Attempt SSO login to console with Okta user that has long group/entitlement attributes (multi-org membership).
2) Observe redirect back to console with 403 and claim-missing error in UI, or immediate 403 for API clients using the same token.
3) Reproduce more reliably by creating a test Okta user with >1500 char 'groups' attribute and initiating auth flow via identity-proxy.
expected_result: Users with valid Okta groups should receive RBAC roles and be able to log in; service accounts should exchange tokens successfully.
actual_result: Identity-proxy drops/truncates the SSO header containing normalized role/group claims when payload exceeds ~1200 bytes; downstream RBAC code receives truncated claim, fails role resolution, returns 403.
logs: 2026-03-10T09:14:22Z identity-proxy gw=proxy-5fdc: WARN claim-header truncated: original_len=1682 trimmed_len=482
2026-03-10T09:14:22Z console svc: ERROR role-resolution failed: missing 'entitlements' claim for user uid=u-3748
2026-03-10T09:16:03Z auth svc: INFO token-exchange success for svc-account-sso (short-claims)
comments: Ava Martinez (reporter) - 2026-03-10: Noticed this during batch onboarding; several new hires hit the same error after Okta claim-normalization rollout yesterday. Attach test user examples.
On-call Identity (Ravi Kapoor) - 2026-03-10: Spun up reproducer with long groups attribute; identity-proxy logs show header truncation. Paging network infra to check edge-proxy header limits.

Network Infra (Liam O'Connor) - 2026-03-11: Edge proxy (ingress-nginx) has default header buffer size of 8k; proxy isn't truncating. Observed truncation inside identity-proxy service at request header assembly step.

SRE (Jin Park) - 2026-03-11: Hypothesis: claim-transform lambda now produces expanded JSON which is serialized into a single header; identity-proxy enforces a 1.2k per-header limit. Need short-term workaround to compress or split claims across headers.

Identity Eng (Ravi Kapoor) - 2026-03-12: Implemented temporary pruning of non-essential entitlements for users in 'self_serve' orgs; rollout to canary reduced 403s for repro users. Full fix in progress.
investigation_notes: Confirmed: failures correlate to users/groups with large aggregated claims after claim-normalization change (rolled 2026-03-09).
Identity-proxy code (header_builder) uses single header 'x-rdwd-claims' and truncates payload to 1200 bytes with a WARN log. This is the truncation point causing RBAC mismatches.
Edge ingress nginx and cloud load balancer are passing headers intact; upstream logs show proxy-side trimming, not network drop.
Reproducer: Okta test user 'onboard-longgroups' with 42 group memberships -> x-rdwd-claims length 1682 -> truncated to 482 -> role resolution fails.
Temporary mitigation reduced exposure by stripping rarely-used entitlement keys for users in self_serve orgs; not acceptable as permanent fix for enterprise/private customers.

Potential root causes: (A) claim-normalization expanded arrays into verbose strings, (B) identity-proxy header size config intentionally conservative to avoid downstream system limits, (C) lack of split-header support in identity-proxy.
resolution: Mitigation applied (2026-03-12): claim-normalization trimmed to only include RBAC-relevant groups for users in 'self_serve' and 'dev' orgs; canary rollout to prod-us-west succeeded for repro cases.
Planned permanent fix: identity-proxy PR #5821 to implement header chunking (split x-rdwd-claims across x-rdwd-claims-1..N) and update console/service to reassemble claims. Target deploy: 2026-03-17.
Follow-up: update runbook 'SSO-Claim-Truncation' in Confluence and add exponential alerts when identity-proxy emits 'claim-header truncated' WARN logs.
Workaround for affected hires: manual RBAC grant by Support (temporary) until full rollout; documented steps in support response template.
follow_up_actions: INT ticket to track PR and rollout: INT-101045 (ensure to pick unique key after creation).
Add monitoring alert: identity-proxy.warn.claim_truncated -> PagerDuty if rate > 5/min over 5m.
Confluence: /internal/runbooks/sso-claim-size -> include guidance for Okta mapping and limits.
Postmortem item: evaluate claim-normalization expansion and add size regression tests to CI.
